notes: Stories created for Enrollment Status feature with full coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status (e.g., RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN) and mapping contract from ClinicalTrials.gov API fields.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize to defined schema, including handling inconsistent or missing status values.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Integrate Enrollment Status into Clinical Trials Service Output
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Augment clinical trials service response to include normalized enrollment status for each trial, ensuring compatibility with existing trial result structure.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Expose Enrollment Status via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Ensure enrollment status is propagated through evaluate_care_facade so it is available to the chat layer and downstream UI rendering.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Enrollment Status
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Create unit tests for status normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API response to facade output.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-2.mitigation: Default unknown or unmapped statuses to UNKNOWN to prevent system failure.
Display normalized status with original source label to preserve trust.
